title: Irish Beef Stew
description: A hearty Irish stew made with tender beef, potatoes, and carrots. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the flour to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the beef broth and red wine to the pot, whisking constantly.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
